not_a_permit: A Harvest Passport is an internal evidence and traceability record. It is not a government permit, a FairWild certificate, a validated local harvest quota, or an assurance of legal compliance or product safety.
access_model: Demo access model: roles are chosen, not signed in. Permissions are checked on the server, but this is not production security; do not store real private documents.

mass_tolerance.label: assumed operational tolerance (configurable), not a scientific or legal standard
